def transform(grid):
    """Mark the overlap of the two patterns separated by a solid divider."""
    sep = next(i for i in range(len(grid[0]))
               if all(row[i] == grid[0][i] != 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
